prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 2024年10月员工工资条 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 8 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "姓名" spans 1 col × 2 row; "应发" spans 3 col × 1 row; "扣款" spans 3 col × 1 row; "实发" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "姓名" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 2: header "应发 › 基本工资" · longest unbreakable word 63px · one-line width 63px
  col 3: header "应发 › 绩效" · longest unbreakable word 59px · one-line width 59px
  col 4: header "应发 › 补贴" · longest unbreakable word 56px · one-line width 56px
  col 5: header "扣款 › 社保" · longest unbreakable word 50px · one-line width 50px
  col 6: header "扣款 › 公积金" · longest unbreakable word 57px · one-line width 57px
  col 7: header "扣款 › 个税" · longest unbreakable word 54px · one-line width 54px
  col 8: header "实发" · longest unbreakable word 64px · one-line width 64px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
This table cannot fit without splitting words at 360px. You MAY choose a total wider than 359px (the reader then scrolls horizontally), or squeeze and accept splits — a design decision.
Rendering convention: the screenshot always shows the WHOLE table. Anything beyond the dashed box is not clipped; it is the part a reader reaches by scrolling sideways, so judge both what fits in the box at first sight and the cost of scrolling to the rest.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"一张中文月度工资条：6名员工，展示应发三项（基本工资、绩效、补贴）、扣款三项（社保、公积金、个税）以及最终实发金额；读者用它核对每人工资的构成、逐项相减是否成立，并比较实发金额。","reading":"按行读：先看姓名，再从左到右看应发各项、扣款各项，最后落到实发；同时也会纵向扫某一列（如个税或实发）找异常。姓名是定位点，实发是阅读终点，中间的六个金额列是同质的“数值带”。","groups":["第1列 姓名：行的锚点，必须与数据行对齐，属于独立角色","第2–4列 应发（基本工资、绩效、补贴）：同组，需要彼此可比、视觉权重一致","第5–7列 扣款（社保、公积金、个税）：同组，与应发组并列、权重一致","第8列 实发：结果列，应与中间六列区分开，宽度和留白上更像“落点”"],"keep_intact":["姓名（2–3字人名不应拆行，否则整行定位失效）","实发金额（每行结论，含两位小数，绝不能断开）","所有金额的整数与小数部分（8600.00 若断成 8600. / 00 就失去可读性与小数对齐）","组表头“应发”“扣款”"],"may_wrap":["四字子表头（基本工资、公积金等）可折成 2+2，表头行本就有两层高度可吸收","姓名列若收窄，人名可折成两行，行高有余量","补贴、社保这类较短金额列（如 600.00、688.00）在极窄时可退让"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [67, 101, 96, 95, 71, 78, 75, 85] · table 669×291px · row heights [36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/10 · tallest cell 1 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 309px
Design r1B: widths [67, 90, 86, 83, 77, 84, 81, 91] · table 660×291px · row heights [36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/10 · tallest cell 1 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 300px

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"姓名和所有金额保持完整；各行高度一致，应发三项在首屏内形成清楚的阅读单元。","problems":"应发数值列留白偏多，首屏只能看到扣款组的一小部分，查看扣款和实发需要较多横向滚动。","cause":"基本工资、绩效、补贴列分别为101、96、95px，均明显大于其内容加内边距所需宽度，合计占用了可用于首屏的空间。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"姓名、金额和表头均未拆行；应发三列比r1A紧凑，首屏已露出扣款组及社保列，组间关系更容易察觉。","problems":"社保金额被视口边界切断，读者仍须滚动才能完整核对；各金额列仍有一定富余，实发列距离首屏较远。","cause":"前四列合计326px，加上表格边界后，360px视口只能容纳社保列的一部分；其余金额列也比保持内容完整所需的宽度略宽。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"紧凑完整","widths":[67,84,80,77,71,78,75,85],"change":"按各列最长内容加21px配置宽度，保留人名、金额和表头完整。总宽617px，比r1B缩短43px；首屏更充分地呈现社保列，并减少查看实发所需的滚动。"},{"name":"适度留白","widths":[67,88,84,81,75,82,79,89],"change":"在内容完整的最低宽度基础上，为各金额列各增加4px，保留较舒展的数值带和结果列。总宽645px，在横向滚动量与列间呼吸感之间取折中。"}]}
